task: Escribe 6 a 8 frases: ¿qué hábitos saludables tienes y cuáles deberías cambiar? Usa should / shouldn't.
paragraphs: Last month my doctor told me I should look after myself better. I worked long hours, I slept only five hours a night and I ate a lot of fast food. So I decided to try a "healthy week".

On Monday I started walking to work instead of taking the bus. It takes thirty minutes, but I felt more awake when I arrived. On Tuesday I didn't have any coffee after lunch, and I went to bed at eleven. It was difficult, but I slept much better.

On Wednesday and Thursday I cooked dinner at home. I made vegetable soup and grilled fish. They were easy recipes and they were cheaper than takeaway food. On Friday I went to a yoga class with a friend. I wasn't very good at it, but I enjoyed it, and I felt very relaxed afterwards.

The weekend was the hardest part. My friends wanted to go out for pizza on Saturday night. I went with them, but I only had one slice and a salad! On Sunday I turned off my phone for the whole afternoon and read a book in the park.
Now I try to follow most of these habits every week. I'm not perfect, but I have more energy and I feel much happier.
